collections.title: Topology and Geometry · Foundations and Further Routes
collections.summary: Begin with spaces, continuity, gluing, homotopy, and coverings. Further routes group the existing geometry and topology lectures by the mathematical background they use.

collections.title: Manifolds, Forms, and Stokes
assumed_background: Multivariable calculus and linear algebra, together with the foundational topology route.

collections.title: Homology, Bundles, Curvature, and Index
assumed_background: Foundational topology, linear algebra, abstract algebra, and calculus on manifolds. Analysis is needed for Hodge and elliptic material.

collections.title: Symplectic Geometry, Curves, and Quantization
assumed_background: Smooth manifolds, forms, bundles, cohomology, differential equations, and analysis; the holomorphic-curve passages require Sobolev and elliptic theory.

collections.title: Spin, Gauge Theory, Floer Theory, and Applications
assumed_background: Bundles and curvature, elliptic operators, Sobolev analysis, symplectic geometry, and the earlier index and holomorphic-curve lectures.
